notes.title: Update 0.30!
notes.content:
[p][b]UPDATE 0.30 OUT![/b] ːsteamhappyː [/p][p][/p][p]Today, the beta 0.30 goes to to the default branch and everyone receives the update with the [b]addition of pipelines, pumps, and automatic crafting[/b]. You can now connect the water pump to the wash plant and froth floater, which increases the yield and gives you more ore. The oil pump can be connected to the asphalt plant to produce more asphalt.[/p][p]We've also added automatic smelting and other tasks related to steel production. The plan is to continue expanding automation until everything can be fully automated. [b]Additionally, larger electrical components[/b] are now included, along with 2 bigger coal plants, marking the first step toward automating power generation. [/p][p]
